caption: The drawing contains a symmetrical composition with a textured beige background. At the top center, there is a stylized cross outlined in rusty red, with inner details filled in yellow and blue. Below the cross, a bow-like shape is oriented horizontally, outlined in blue with yellow and red details and a small central circle where the lines meet. On either side of the bow, two gold-colored wings or leaf shapes with three red tips extend outward. At the bottom of the composition, there is a large circular disk containing an ornate, mandala-like pattern. This pattern consists of concentric circles and geometric elements in shades of red, blue, and yellow, with repeating pointed shapes and curved lines radiating from the center. The entire artwork is outlined and detailed with rusty red and blue lines, and the color palette consists primarily of yellow-gold, rusty red, and blue tones. The background has a parchment-like, aged appearance.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
